name: XnRetro
blurb: XnRetro allows you to create stunning images with vintage or instant effect on your Desktop.
description:
XnRetro allows you to create stunning images with vintage or instant effect on your Desktop.

Features:

• 20 color effects

• 15 light effects such as bokeh, leak

• 28 frame borders

• Adjustment like contrast, gamma, saturation, ...

• Vignetting

• Noise

• Save or share the result

XnRetro is provided as freeware.
